nightly-bot: ALERT 00:15 UTC: runtime-serving-prod p95 latency +2.5x over baseline for last 30m. Affected: kernel-selector decision path. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/alerts/2218456789 :rotating_light:\nmaria: looking now — spike starts at ~23:56 UTC and is sustained across multiple hosts
akshay: which deploy went out around then?
jen: there was a canary merge earlier — PR#4721 'adaptive-batcher: introduce soft-throttle' merged at 23:50 UTC (sha: a1b2c3d)
samir: CI perf job also flaked on nightly-run: `perf-run-serve` shows `p95: 110ms -> 340ms` on commit a1b2c3d
maria: i can repro locally with the integration harness at low qps. kv cache hit-rate dips during bursts, cause looks like more evictions
akshay: tracing shows kernel selection falling back to slower kernel for some seq-len>1024 batches
jen: logs from canary node:
```
[23:52:03] selector: chose kernel_v2_fallback
[23:52:03] batcher: throttled to 16 from 64
[23:52:04] kvcache: eviction-ratio 0.42
```
\nmaria: hypothesis: soft-throttle reduces batch sizes -> increased unique keys per unit time -> KV cache pressure -> more evictions -> prober prefers fallback kernel -> higher p95
samir: can we revert PR#4721 to confirm causality?
jen: :thumbsup: staging a revert to canary now. rolling back to a0f0e0e (pre-PR) in ~10m
akshay: also, CI perf didn't catch because nightly harness uses `--seq-len 512`. prod tail has many 1024+ sequences; add seq-len variation to catch this
maria: recording perf snippet to perf-regressions repo and adding a quick dashboard panel for kernel selection counts
nightly-bot: Revert deployed to canary at 00:33 UTC. Monitoring...
jen: canary p95 back to baseline within 6 minutes. revert of PR#4721 looks like it restores behavior
akshay: filing revert PR and follow-up: "adaptive-batcher: respect kv-cache pressure + add seq-len tests"
jen: assigning follow-up to @maria and @samir for root-cause. i'll bump CI perf harness to include seq-len=1024 and emit kernel-selection metrics
maria: thanks — i'll draft a short postmortem and post in eng-runtime when we finish the RCA
